_comment: In-place-in-spirit smali edits applied to classes.dex. Some fixes cannot be expressed as a byte patch because they need extra instructions (the method has no slack), so the dex is decoded with baksmali, the listed snippets are inserted at the start of the named method, and the dex is reassembled. The edits are declarative and the whole step is cached by input hash, so it is reproducible. The apktool jar is referenced, not vendored; its digest is pinned here and checked by `pixi run doctor`.

rules.insert:
# unity JNIBridge proxy: Android 16 added default interface methods
    # (ServiceConnection.onServiceConnected(.., IBinderSession)). Unity forwards
    # every proxied call to the C# side, which has no implementation, and the
    # native bridge throws NoSuchMethodError on the main thread. Ignore default
    # methods instead of forwarding them. Method.isDefault() is API 24+, and
    # default interface methods do not exist before that, so the check is skipped below 24 and run at or above it. (It was inverted, so it never ran on the devices that need it.)
    sget v0, Landroid/os/Build$VERSION;->SDK_INT:I
    const/16 v1, 0x18
    if-lt v0, v1, :jnibridge_not_default
    goto :jnibridge_not_default
    :jnibridge_sdk_ok
    invoke-virtual {p2}, Ljava/lang/reflect/Method;->isDefault()Z
    move-result v0
    if-eqz v0, :jnibridge_not_default
    const/4 v0, 0x0
    return-object v0
    :jnibridge_not_default
rules.comment: Android 16+/17: default interface method from the framework kills the game when billing connects
